about: One guest room, as /en/camp is one camp: a third of the compound's guest-room block (src/components/home/compound.json, unit "rooms": two 40 ft containers joined side by side, 12.192 x 4.876 m, three rooms, front east onto a 1.5 m timber veranda under a slatted shade). Each room is 4.064 m along the block and 4.876 m deep. As in the 2026-10-25 footage (assets/reference/rooms, rooms-planned, room): on the front, a barred red-framed window left of a red door with a barred glass panel; a second barred window in the back wall; cream walls; red steel posts where the two containers were joined, across the middle of the room. No en-suite shows in the footage, so there is none: guests use the compound's public bathroom. The floor is bare plywood today; it is drawn in the studio's oak planks, and the furniture in the studio's Medium Oak. The 2D (guest-room-plan.tsx) and the 3D (scripts/site/render/guest-room.html) both read this file. Plan in metres: x to the right along the block, y toward the front (the door), the room's centre at 0,0. Furniture sizes and places are design choices, not yet sourced.

block.about: The room's share of the block, outside the steel: 12.192 / 3 long, two container widths deep. The stone plinth lifts it 0.3 m; the floor sits on the container's 0.14 m bottom rail.

room.about: Inside the linings: partitions to the neighbouring rooms left and right, the containers' long walls front and back. Ceiling height after the cove seen in the footage.

joint.about: Where the two containers were joined, the middle wall is gone; two red steel posts stand against the partitions and a beam runs overhead, as in the footage.

door.about: Red steel door with a barred glass panel in its upper half, hinged on the right, opening in against the right wall.

window.about: Red-framed, barred, opening outward: one on the front left of the door, one in the back wall over the bed.

veranda.about: Timber boards the length of the block, 1.5 m deep, a step down in front of each door, a slatted shade overhead on posts along its edge (shown dashed in the 2D, left off the 3D so the room shows). Under the window, two slatted chairs and a small round table, as on the camp's porch.

bed.about: A 160 x 200 cm double, headboard against the back wall under its window, white bedding, two pillows, a mustard throw at the foot.

bedsides.about: A bedside table each side with a linen-shade lamp.

bench.about: Luggage bench across the foot of the bed.

wardrobe.about: Two-door wardrobe on the left wall, between the joint post and the desk.

desk.about: A small desk under the front window with a chair facing the window.

hooks.about: A rail of coat hooks on the right wall, clear of the door's swing.

rug.about: Woven rug under the lower two thirds of the bed.

electric.about: The room's wiring in the studio's pattern (D-021): its own surface unit board, a double-pole main switch and type 2 surge protection, one RCBO 30 mA type A per circuit, cables in conduit in the linings. The supply is a cable from the farm's site board (the power guide); its size is the electrician's, to the run's length. Points in plan metres (x, y as the plan, z above the floor) at their centre, facing out of their wall; size in mm (w, h, d). design_A: lights and the fan from their watts at 230 V; sockets and the AC provision at the studio's design loads (C2 and C7). rwf: the studio BOM's placeholder unit prices (AS-21), not quotes. No en-suite is drawn (see about), so there is no plumbing and no water-heater circuit yet.

circuits.serves: Sockets: the bed, the desk and the cleaning socket

points.description: Unit board, 12 modules, on the right wall by the bed
Ceiling light, by the door and the desk
Two-gang switch by the door, past its swing: L1 and L2
Wall fan 300 mm, high on the left wall over the bed
Socket + USB-C beside the left bedside table, for its lamp and a phone
Socket + USB-C beside the right bedside table, for its lamp and a phone
Double socket by the desk, for its lamp and a laptop
Double socket on the right wall: cleaning, a kettle, the luggage bench
AC provision: isolator high on the back wall, for a split unit later
Smoke alarm, 10-year battery, on the ceiling by the door
